name: Quotalis – Request a Quote & Catalog Mode for WooCommerce
author: toitoinne

sections.description:
Quotalis turns your WooCommerce shop into a catalog where professional customers request a quote instead of buying — with the essentials in the free version:

  • Catalog mode: hide prices and/or “Add to cart” on all products or only selected categories, and replace buying with quote requests.

  • “Add to quote” button on product pages and on shop / category pages.

  • Works with simple, variable and price-less products (“price on request”).
  • Quote page where customers adjust quantities, remove items and send their request.
  • Customizable form: add your own fields (company, VAT ID, phone, delivery date…) in one line each.
  • Request management in WooCommerce: list with company, total and status (new, quote sent, accepted, refused).
  • Edit quantities, unit prices, VAT rate and discount before answering.
  • Printable quote (save as PDF from your browser) with numbering (DEV-2026-0001), validity date, totals excl./incl. VAT, signature box.
  • French legal mentions ready: free/chargeable quote, validity, payment terms, VAT exemption mention (art. 293 B CGI), custom legal mentions.
  • Email notifications to the shop (with reply-to the customer) and confirmation to the customer.
  • Anti-spam without CAPTCHA: honeypot, minimum time, rate limit.
  • No JavaScript required, compatible with page builders (shortcodes [quotalis_quote] and [quotalis_button id="123"]).
  • Your data stays in WordPress: quote requests are stored in your database; nothing is shared unless you activate a Quotalis Pro licence (see “External services”).
  • Fully translated in French.

En français

Devis WooCommerce, demande de devis, mode catalogue, masquer les prix :
Quotalis transforme votre boutique en catalogue (prix et bouton panier masquables) où vos clients professionnels demandent un devis au lieu d’acheter : bouton « Ajouter au devis » sur les fiches produits et la boutique, page « Mon devis », formulaire personnalisable, gestion des demandes, devis imprimable en PDF avec les mentions usuelles en France (validité, gratuité, conditions de paiement, franchise de TVA art. 293 B du CGI). Certaines activités (bâtiment, dépannage…) exigent des mentions supplémentaires : ajoutez-les dans les réglages et vérifiez les règles officielles de votre métier.

External services

Quotalis includes the Freemius SDK (GPL), used only for the optional Quotalis Pro add-on:

  • No usage data, no opt-in screen: Quotalis opens directly after installation or update. The free plugin does not send any usage data on its own.
  • Quotalis Pro add-on licensing: if you buy and activate the optional Quotalis Pro add-on, the licence key is sent to Freemius together with the site URL, name and language, the WordPress, PHP and plugin versions and the administrator’s name and email, to activate and check the licence. Purchases are processed by Freemius as reseller.

No request is sent to Freemius (wp.freemius.com, api.freemius.com) unless you activate a Quotalis Pro licence.

Service provider: Freemius, Inc. — Terms of Service — Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Quotalis from Plugins > Add New, then activate it.
  3. A “My quote” page is created automatically.
  4. Configure it in WooCommerce > Quotalis (company details for the quote document, form fields, hidden prices…).
sections.faq:
Does it send my data anywhere?

Quote requests and customer data never leave your site: they are stored in your WordPress database and emails are sent by your site. Quotalis uses the Freemius SDK only for the optional Quotalis Pro add-on licence; there is no opt-in screen and nothing is sent unless you activate a Pro licence (see “External services”).

Can customers request a quote for products without a price?

Yes. Price-less products show “Add to quote” and appear as “On request”; you set the price when answering.

How do I create a PDF?

Open a request and click “Open printable quote”, then use your browser’s “Save as PDF”.

Is the quote document legally sufficient in France?

It contains the usual mentions of a quote. Some trades require additional mentions: add them in the settings and check the official rules for your activity.

How do I hide prices and the Add to cart button? / Comment masquer les prix ?

WooCommerce > Quotalis: tick “Hide prices” and/or “Hide Add to cart”, choose categories (empty = whole shop). / Cochez « Masquer les prix » et choisissez les catégories.

Can customers accept the quote online and pay?

The free plugin sends a printable quote. The optional Quotalis Pro add-on lets customers accept online (“Bon pour accord”), creates the WooCommerce order at the negotiated price and sends them to payment.

Does Quotalis include French legal mentions for quotes? / Mentions légales françaises ?

Yes: validity, free or chargeable quote, payment terms, VAT exemption (art. 293 B CGI), custom mentions and the “Bon pour accord” signature box.
sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • Freemius SDK added, used only to license the optional Quotalis Pro add-on. No opt-in screen; nothing is sent unless you activate a Pro licence — see “External services”.
  • Better documentation and FAQ; screenshots.
  • French translation now also loads on WordPress 6.7.

0.1.1

  • The plugin is now called Quotalis (it was submitted as “Devisly”).
  • Catalog mode is now enforced on the server: products with a hidden price or a hidden “Add to cart” button can no longer be added to the cart (direct link, AJAX, cart API), and are removed from existing carts.
  • Hidden prices are also removed from the product structured data, the variation data and the public product API.
  • The quote page is never served from a page cache; “Add to quote” keeps working on cached shop pages.
  • Anti-spam limit raised to 20 requests per hour and per IP (filter quotalis_rate_limit_per_hour).
  • Styles and scripts are enqueued with the WordPress functions; translations are loaded by WordPress (requires WordPress 6.7).

0.1.0

  • First version.
